# Healthy Mind Specialists

> Psychologists, therapists, and coaches in Riverview, Florida (Tampa Bay). Therapy for anxiety, OCD, trauma (including EMDR), relationships, and life transitions, plus psychological, ADHD, and autism evaluations for children, teens, and adults. In person in Riverview or online throughout Florida and beyond. Therapy available in English and Spanish.

## About

Healthy Mind Specialists is an integrative psychological practice at 11906 Boyette Rd, Riverview, FL 33569, serving Riverview, Brandon, Valrico, Lithia, Tampa, and the greater Tampa Bay area. Open Monday–Friday, 8 AM–9 PM. Phone: 813-609-2034. Email: info@healthymindspecialists.com.

Insurance: we currently accept Alma, Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS), Carelon Behavioral Health, Cigna, Curative, Florida Blue, Optum, Oscar, Oxford, Providence Health Plan, and UnitedHealthcare (UHC).

## Services

- [Individual Therapy](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/services/individual-therapy): One-on-one therapy for anxiety, OCD, phobias, relationships, women's mental health, and personal growth.
- [EMDR Therapy](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/services/emdr): Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing for trauma, PTSD, anxiety, and phobias.
- [Group Therapy](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/services/group-therapy): Therapist-guided groups for anxiety, grief, and more.
- [Integrative Care](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/services/integrative-care): Care addressing mental, emotional, physical, social, and spiritual needs.
- [Affordable Therapy](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/services/affordable-therapy): Evidence-based therapy at accessible self-pay rates with doctoral-level clinicians supervised by licensed psychologists.
- [Life Coaching](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/services/coaching): Goal-oriented coaching for executive functioning, confidence, life transitions, and accountability.
- [Supervision & Consultation](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/services/supervision-and-consultation): Clinical supervision for counselors and psychologists working toward licensure.

## Psychological Testing

- [Psychological Evaluations](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/services/evaluations): Evaluations of cognitive, emotional, and behavioral functioning for diagnosis and treatment planning, with a written report and feedback session.
- [Online ADHD Evaluations](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/services/online-adhd-evaluations): Telehealth ADHD evaluations for adolescents and adults, from screener to full evaluation.
- [Autism Spectrum Evaluation](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/services/autism-evaluation): ADOS-2 and ADI-R based autism evaluations for children, teens, and adults.

## Programs

- [Back to Calm](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/programs/back-to-calm): A 60-minute emotional support session with Morgan Adams, MSW. Not formal therapy. $125, online or in person.
- [Strong Mind Teens](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/programs/strong-mind-teens): A 6-week coaching program for adolescents with Traci Adams, CLC.
- [Workshops & Groups](https://www.healthymindspecialists.com/programs/workshops): Workshops, clinical intensives, and trainings for the community and mental health professionals.
